rumors.text: The Baron's wig is actually a trained spider.
rumors.followup: The wig was just a wig. The spider was the Baron, who has since been asked to step down.

rumors.text: The local priest accepts donations in copper pieces only.
rumors.followup: The priest now also accepts electrum, on the grounds that it is "copper's fancy cousin."

rumors.text: There's a secret tunnel from the tavern to the castle.
rumors.followup: The tunnel exists. It goes to the castle's wine cellar, which explains the castle's wine shortage.

rumors.text: The baker's bread makes you temporarily invisible.
rumors.followup: The bread doesn't make you invisible. The baker has simply stopped seeing customers who don't tip.

rumors.text: The town well is haunted by a disgruntled water elemental.
rumors.followup: The elemental was disgruntled about the coins people throw in. It has started throwing them back.

rumors.text: Someone's been stealing the left shoe from every pair in town.
rumors.followup: The shoes turned up in a hollow tree. A one-legged ogre has been building a very specific wardrobe.

rumors.text: The blacksmith is actually a retired dragon in human form.
rumors.followup: The blacksmith denies it, but his forge has not needed coal in nineteen years.

rumors.text: Every mirror in town shows you 5 years younger.
rumors.followup: The mirrors were enchanted by a vain mayor. The enchantment wore off and three people fainted.

rumors.text: The local bard is secretly funding the adventurers' guild.
rumors.followup: Confirmed. The bard is now demanding royalties on every ballad about the guild.

rumors.text: There's a ghost in the library who only haunts bad poetry.
rumors.followup: The ghost has published a pamphlet of his own poetry. The library ghost who haunts bad poetry is furious.

rumors.text: The baker needs yeast from a Giant's cave (Giant is on keto).
rumors.followup: The giant traded the yeast for a sourdough starter and a gluten-free recipe. Everyone left happy and slightly bloated.

rumors.text: Town crier lost his voice. Suspected curse. Needs removal.
rumors.followup: The curse was a cold. The crier was given honey and a stern talking-to about shouting in the rain.

rumors.text: Statue in the square changes pose every night. Investigate.
rumors.followup: The statue was practicing poses for a sculptor who never finished it. Someone finally carved it a chair.

rumors.text: Stray dog is actually a polymorphed noble. Break curse.
rumors.followup: The noble was broken free of the curse and immediately asked for his old dog bed back.

rumors.text: Festival prize stolen before judging. Find the thief.
rumors.followup: The thief was the festival goat. It ate the prize ribbon and was awarded second place anyway.

rumors.text: Orphanage needs donations or monster clearing.
rumors.followup: The orphanage got both. The monster stayed on as a groundskeeper.

rumors.text: Bridge collapse blamed on rust monster. Hunt it.
rumors.followup: There was no rust monster. The bridge was just old. The town council has been very quiet since.

rumors.text: Local hero's statue coming to life. Contain it.
rumors.followup: The statue walked to the tavern, ordered a drink, and has refused to go back to its plinth.

rumors.text: Baker's bread rising too fast. Yeast elemental in oven?
rumors.followup: It was a yeast elemental. It now works the night shift and the bread has never been better.

rumors.text: Town drunk claims he slew a god. Verify or silence.
rumors.followup: The god turned out to be a very large goose with a temple. The goose is fine. The drunk is now a hero.

rumors.text: The miller has been grinding something other than wheat after midnight. The flour tastes faintly of regret.
rumors.followup: The miller was grinding old grudges into flour for a hedge witch. Sales of "humble pie" are up.

rumors.text: The innkeeper waters down the ale, but only for people who complain about the ale.
rumors.followup: Three more people complained. The ale is now mostly water, and the complaints are now mostly about the water.

rumors.text: The town's oldest resident is turning 300 next week and still won't say what race she is.
rumors.followup: She turned 300, opened a gift, and said "elf." Nobody believes her.

rumors.text: Somebody keeps repainting the 'Welcome' sign to say 'Turn Back.' The handwriting is very neat.
rumors.followup: The sign painter was caught. She's a retired adventurer who has seen what's down the road.

rumors.text: The cobbler's apprentice can talk to rats, and the rats have opinions about the cobbler.
rumors.followup: The rats have unionized and the cobbler now provides cheese breaks.

rumors.text: The constable hasn't made an arrest in six years. Crime is either very low or very well organized.
rumors.followup: It was organized. The constable has been arrested by the thieves' guild for "unfair competition."

rumors.text: The duck pond is bottomless. Three ducks have confirmed this and not come back.
rumors.followup: A fourth duck went in with a rope tied to its foot. The rope came back dry and tied in a neat bow.

rumors.text: The widow on Lantern Lane has buried four husbands, and every one of them left her a cursed heirloom.
rumors.followup: The fifth suitor has arrived. He brought his own cursed heirloom, just to be fair.

rumors.text: The tavern's 'secret recipe' stew is whatever the adventurers didn't finish last night.
rumors.followup: Confirmed by an adventurer who found her own boot in the stew.

rumors.text: The church bells ring a thirteenth time at midnight, and only dogs and drunks can hear it.
rumors.followup: The thirteenth bell was traced to a bell-ringer who can't count. He's been given a twelve-bell rota.

rumors.text: The schoolteacher is quietly paying off the goblins so they'll skip the schoolhouse during raids.
rumors.followup: The goblins have started sending the schoolteacher thank-you notes. In crayon.

rumors.text: The night watchman sleeps on duty, but his lantern keeps walking the route without him.
rumors.followup: The lantern was caught on the watchman's route alone and has been offered his job.

rumors.text: The scarecrow in Farmer Odo's field has been seen voting in the council elections.
rumors.followup: The scarecrow lost the election by two votes. It is demanding a recount.

rumors.text: The herbalist's 'love tonic' is just strong tea. Her marriage rate is still suspiciously high.
rumors.followup: A study found the tea works if you drink it with someone you already like. Her prices went up.

rumors.text: The fountain in the square grants wishes, but only wishes for slightly damp coins.
rumors.followup: Someone finally wished for dry coins. The fountain granted it, then flooded the square out of spite.

rumors.text: Two families have feuded for a century over a goat. The goat is still alive.
rumors.followup: The goat died at the age of 104. Both families are now feuding over the will.

rumors.text: The gravedigger has been digging one more grave than the town needs every month.
rumors.followup: The extra graves are for the gravedigger's ex-wives. All of them are still alive. He's just optimistic.

rumors.text: The tavern cat has a tab, and it's paid up.
rumors.followup: The cat has started buying rounds. The innkeeper is worried about its liver.

rumors.text: The new lamplighter only works on nights with no moon, and nobody hired him.
rumors.followup: The lamplighter is a will-o'-wisp working off a debt. He's very good at the job.

rumors.text: The mayor's portrait blinks during council meetings. Nobody has dared mention it.
rumors.followup: The portrait blinked again. The mayor now holds meetings facing the wall.

rumors.text: The midwife's satchel was stolen with a newborn's true name inside. Get it back before someone uses it.
rumors.followup: The satchel was found in a crow's nest. The crow now knows a name it shouldn't and is being very smug.

rumors.text: The town clock stopped at 3:17 and so did everyone's aging. Find out who wound it down.
rumors.followup: A clockmaker's apprentice wound it down to stop his own birthday. The town has aged six months overnight.

rumors.text: Chickens keep laying eggs with tiny maps inside. Follow the yolks.
rumors.followup: The yolks led to a buried chicken coop full of gold. The chickens want their cut.

rumors.text: The harvest festival needs a new champion pie judge. The last three were poisoned.
rumors.followup: The new judge brought a food taster. The food taster brought a food taster.

rumors.text: A traveling circus left town but forgot its strongman. He doesn't remember where they were headed.
rumors.followup: The circus sent a postcard: "Forgot something?" The strongman has opened a gym.

rumors.text: Somebody is stealing doors. Not what's behind them, just the doors.
rumors.followup: The doors were being collected by a door mimic who wanted company. It has been gently returned to the wild.

rumors.text: Wolves are leaving dead rabbits on the chapel steps like offerings. The priest wants to know who taught them.
rumors.followup: The wolves were trained by a ranger who thought the priest looked hungry.

rumors.text: The well water turned sweet overnight. The alchemist wants a barrel tested before the children drink more.
rumors.followup: A friendly sugar elemental moved into the well. The town dentist is hiring.

rumors.text: The bell tower's bell was replaced with a forgery. The real one is ringing somewhere underground.
rumors.followup: The real bell was found ringing in a kobold warren. The kobolds were using it for dinner.

rumors.text: A lost child returned from the woods after a week and now speaks only in rhyme. Find out what she met.
rumors.followup: She met the fey court. She won a rhyming contest and now has a title, a lute, and no off switch.

rumors.text: Every candle in the chandlery melts into the same shape: a key. Find the lock.
rumors.followup: The lock was found under the chandlery floor. Behind it was another candle shaped like a key.

rumors.text: The King is actually three goblins in a trench coat.
rumors.followup: The trench coat has been confiscated. The King is now three goblins in a cape.

rumors.text: The Queen has outlawed the color purple on Tuesdays.
rumors.followup: The ban was a typo. It was supposed to be "puce." Puce traders are relieved, then furious.

rumors.text: The royal tax collector is a vampire.
rumors.followup: The tax collector is not a vampire. He just never comes out in daylight because everyone throws things.

rumors.text: The next election will be decided by trial by combat.
rumors.followup: The trial happened. Both candidates lost. The current ruler is the referee.

rumors.text: The Duke is secretly funding both sides of the war.
rumors.followup: The Duke's ledgers were leaked. He was also funding a third side nobody knew about.

rumors.text: The kingdom's borders are shifting 1 inch per day.
rumors.followup: The borders are moving. A surveyor's donkey has been nudging the stones one inch at a time.

rumors.text: The royal advisor is a polymorphed owl.
rumors.followup: The advisor was an owl all along. His advice, "who," has been surprisingly effective.

rumors.text: New law: All dragons must register as small businesses.
rumors.followup: Twelve dragons registered. Eleven listed "hoarding" as a business expense.

rumors.text: The crown prince is missing and nobody's noticed.
rumors.followup: The prince was found in a tavern with a fake mustache. Nobody noticed he was back either.

rumors.text: The kingdom is actually a simulation created by wizards.
rumors.followup: The wizards behind the simulation issued a statement denying they exist.

rumors.text: Ambassador needs escort to the border. High pay.
rumors.followup: The ambassador was escorted safely to the border and then asked to go back. He forgot his hat.

rumors.text: Treaty document stolen from the vault. Retrieve it.
rumors.followup: The treaty was found under a cat in the vault. The cat has been made a minor noble.

rumors.text: Rebels planning to storm the armory. Stop them.
rumors.followup: The rebels stormed the armory and found it empty. The guards had pawned the weapons months ago.

rumors.text: New law requires all swords to be registered. Enforce it.
rumors.followup: Swords are registered. Daggers are now very fashionable.

rumors.text: Spy network discovered in the post office. Expose them.
rumors.followup: The spies were all spying on each other. The post office is the best-informed building in the realm.

rumors.text: King's tax collector is missing. Find him (alive).
rumors.followup: The tax collector was found alive and hiding in a monastery. He has taken a vow of never collecting.

rumors.text: Ambassador demands tribute of rare wine. Fetch it.
rumors.followup: The rare wine was vinegar. The ambassador loved it. Nobody is telling him.

rumors.text: Election ballots eaten by mimic. Find the mimic.
rumors.followup: The mimic was disguised as the ballot box. It has been elected to the council by write-in.

rumors.text: The High Council's new 'transparency initiative' is a single window, painted shut.
rumors.followup: Someone opened the painted window. The council is investigating the "breach."

rumors.text: The Lord Treasurer hasn't counted the treasury in years because he's afraid of what he'll find.
rumors.followup: He counted. The treasury was fine. He has never been more frightened.

rumors.text: The court jester is the only one at court allowed to tell the truth, so the king fired him.
rumors.followup: The jester was rehired as a minister. Court has never been so honest or so awkward.

rumors.text: The new tax on chimneys has made smoke a status symbol among the nobility.
rumors.followup: Chimneys are now built for show on houses without fires. The poor are taxed on smoke they don't make.

rumors.text: The royal food taster has developed an immunity to every poison and now demands a raise.
rumors.followup: The taster has formed a union of one and won.

rumors.text: Both candidates for Guild Speaker are being funded by the same dwarf.
rumors.followup: The dwarf won both elections and has appointed himself Speaker of the Speakers.

rumors.text: The border wall was finished last month. Someone built a door in it this month.
rumors.followup: The door has a toll booth now. The toll is cheaper than the wall was.

rumors.text: The Ministry of Roads spent its whole budget on a report about why the roads are bad.
rumors.followup: The report recommends a second report. Funding has been approved.

rumors.text: The Duchess has been dead for two years and her decrees keep coming.
rumors.followup: The Duchess was a ghost. Her decrees were very sensible and will be missed.

rumors.text: The peace treaty with the orc clans was signed in ink that fades after a year. The year is almost up.
rumors.followup: The ink faded early. Both sides held a surprised party and signed again in blood. Orc blood. Volunteered.

rumors.text: The royal heralds now charge by the syllable, so all proclamations are very short and slightly rude.
rumors.followup: The heralds were fined for rudeness. They paid in the fewest coins possible.

rumors.text: The Council voted to study whether the Council has too many committees. A committee will report back.
rumors.followup: The committee reports that yes, there are too many committees. A committee was formed to reduce them.

rumors.text: The king's twin brother has been ruling every other week and nobody can tell the difference.
rumors.followup: The twin brother was found out because he was nicer. He has been asked to stay.

rumors.text: Every new law must now be read aloud in full at the town gate. The gate crier quit after the tax code.
rumors.followup: The gate crier is now reading the tax code in shifts. He's been at it for three weeks.

rumors.text: The Elven embassy has been 'arriving soon' for eighty years. By elf standards, that's punctual.
rumors.followup: The elves arrived. They're early, they say, for a different visit.

rumors.text: Votes in the last election were counted by a hired ogre. He can count to eleven.
rumors.followup: The ogre was retrained. He can now count to twelve and the turnout went up by one.

rumors.text: The Lord Chancellor's hat is a hat of disguise. Nobody knows who has been chancellor all this time.
rumors.followup: The hat was removed. The Lord Chancellor was a goat the whole time, and the kingdom was well run.

rumors.text: The new 'Ministry of Efficiency' has hired forty clerks to make sure the other ministries aren't hiring too many clerks.
rumors.followup: The Ministry of Efficiency was found to be inefficient. A Ministry of Ministry Oversight is being formed.

rumors.text: A hedge wizard predicted the next three royal scandals. Two have already happened.
rumors.followup: The third scandal happened. It was about the hedge wizard.

rumors.text: The royal marriage is purely political. The love letters are purely ghostwritten.
rumors.followup: A love letter was intercepted. It was ghostwritten by the other spouse's ghostwriter. They're dating now.

rumors.text: The town council meets in the tavern now 'to stay close to the people.' The tab is paid from the road fund.
rumors.followup: The road fund ran out. The council is now meeting on the road.

rumors.text: A senator's signet ring went missing the night before a key vote. Find it before someone seals a law with it.
rumors.followup: The ring was found on a pickled egg at the bar. The law sealed with it bans pickled eggs.

rumors.text: The king's speechwriter vanished with next week's address. The king is improvising. Please hurry.
rumors.followup: The king improvised. His speech was the best-received address in the kingdom's history. The speechwriter has been told to stay lost.

rumors.text: Somebody is replacing the tax collectors with polite, helpful doppelgangers. The Treasury wants to know why revenue is up.
rumors.followup: The doppelgangers were hired by the Treasury. The Treasury is investigating itself.

rumors.text: Two rival dukes have hired the same assassin. The assassin wants a mediator.
rumors.followup: The mediator convinced both dukes to hire each other instead. The assassin is now unemployed and bitter.

rumors.text: Ballots for the guild election are being eaten by a goat. The goat may have been bribed.
rumors.followup: The goat was bribed. It has refused to say by whom and is now under royal protection.

rumors.text: The royal seal has been forged on a decree pardoning every pickpocket in the city. Find the forger.
rumors.followup: The forger was a pickpocket with very good handwriting. He has been pardoned by his own decree.

rumors.text: An exiled noble is hiring bodyguards for a 'quiet' return to court. Pay is high. Quiet is unlikely.
rumors.followup: The noble returned "quietly" with a brass band. Three bodyguards resigned during the parade.

rumors.text: The court astrologer's charts have been tampered with to predict the queen's downfall. Find out by whom.
rumors.followup: The astrologer tampered with his own charts. He was trying to predict a raise.

rumors.text: A treaty must be delivered across three borders in five days. Every border guard has been bribed to lose it.
rumors.followup: The treaty arrived on day five, carried by a pigeon. The bribed guards have filed for a refund.

rumors.text: A minor lord wants proof his rival is a werewolf before the next full moon council.
rumors.followup: The rival is not a werewolf. He is, however, a werebadger, which the council found more troubling.

rumors.text: The parliament's speaking stick was stolen. Without it, nobody is legally allowed to talk. Some call it a blessing.
rumors.followup: The stick was found in the Speaker's dog's bed. The chamber had its quietest session in history.

rumors.text: Riots planned for market day. The mayor wants them stopped. The rioters want their grain back.
rumors.followup: The grain was given back. The riot became a picnic. The mayor claimed credit.

rumors.text: Gold pieces are losing value due to dragon hoarding.
rumors.followup: A dragon was asked to spend some of its hoard. It bought another, smaller hoard.

rumors.text: The Merchant's Guild is manipulating potion prices.
rumors.followup: The Guild admitted it. Potion prices went up to cover the cost of the apology.

rumors.text: A new currency made of dragon scales is being introduced.
rumors.followup: The dragon-scale coin was introduced and recalled the same day. The dragon wanted its scales back.

rumors.text: Healing potions will be rationed next month.
rumors.followup: Rationing began. The black market in healing potions is now healthier than its customers.

rumors.text: The local bank is actually a lich's phylactery.
rumors.followup: The bank was not a phylactery. The lich is just a very patient customer with a high-interest account.

rumors.text: Inflation is caused by too many +1 swords in circulation.
rumors.followup: Swordsmiths have been asked to make +0 swords to cool the market. Nobody wants one.

rumors.text: The Adventurer's Guild is going public on the Realm Market Exchange.
rumors.followup: The Guild went public. Its share price rose sharply, then fell into a pit trap.

rumors.text: Magic items are now subject to luxury tax.
rumors.followup: The tax passed. Wizards are now declaring their staffs as "walking aids."

rumors.text: A monopoly on torches has been declared illegal.
rumors.followup: The torch monopoly was broken. Torch prices dropped, then caught fire.

rumors.text: The price of arrows doubled after a rogue's union strike.
rumors.followup: The rogues won their strike. Arrows are cheaper, but they now come pre-stolen.

rumors.text: Merchant needs protection from rival guild. Bodyguard duty.
rumors.followup: The rival guild sent a bodyguard too. The two bodyguards are now married.

rumors.text: Counterfeit gold pieces circulating. Find the source.
rumors.followup: The counterfeits were traced to a mint employee who "just wanted to see if he could." He could.

rumors.text: Silk road blocked by giant spiders. Clear the path.
rumors.followup: The spiders were cleared and the silk was sold. The merchants now want the spiders back.

rumors.text: Innkeeper needs help evicting a squatter (it's a lich).
rumors.followup: The lich was evicted. He left a one-star review.

rumors.text: Gem mine flooded with water elementals. Drain it.
rumors.followup: The elementals were drained. They are now working in the town bathhouse.

rumors.text: Caravan late by two weeks. Send search party.
rumors.followup: The caravan was found, stuck behind a slower caravan.

rumors.text: Smugglers using portable holes. Confiscate them.
rumors.followup: The portable holes were confiscated and stored in a portable hole. The watch is still looking for them.

rumors.text: Price of steel spikes skyrocketing. Investigate monopoly.
rumors.followup: A single dwarf had bought every spike in three kingdoms. He is building a very spiky house.

rumors.text: Bank vault door stuck. Need strong party to open.
rumors.followup: The vault door opened, revealing a second vault door. The bank is hiring a stronger party.

rumors.text: Silver is up because a vampire lord is quietly buying all of it.
rumors.followup: The vampire lord is now selling silver. Nobody understands his business model.

rumors.text: The Moneylenders' Guild now charges interest on the interest on the interest.
rumors.followup: The guild was audited. The auditor's report has interest on it.

rumors.text: Copper coins are being melted down for pots because the pots are worth more than the coins.
rumors.followup: The pots are now being melted down for coins. The economy has gone in a circle.

rumors.text: A halfling has cornered the market on second breakfasts.
rumors.followup: The halfling's monopoly was broken by a third breakfast.

rumors.text: Dungeon real estate is booming. Investors want 'cleared, with original traps.'
rumors.followup: The first "cleared with original traps" dungeon sold. The buyer has not been seen.

rumors.text: The price of rope has tripled. Everyone suspects the adventurers. The adventurers suspect the rope.
rumors.followup: It was the rope. The rope had unionized.

rumors.text: A merchant prince is offering shares in a caravan that hasn't left yet, to a city that doesn't exist yet.
rumors.followup: The caravan left. The city now exists. Nobody knows who built it.

rumors.text: Tavern prices go up every time a party of adventurers walks in. The innkeeper calls it 'dynamic pricing.'
rumors.followup: The innkeeper's prices now go down when bards walk in. Bards have started dressing as adventurers.

rumors.text: The royal mint has been printing coins with the wrong king's face for a month and nobody noticed.
rumors.followup: The coins were recalled. The wrong king has asked for a share of the seigniorage.

rumors.text: The guild of locksmiths and the guild of thieves share an accountant.
rumors.followup: The accountant has been arrested by both guilds and is being held in a cell with excellent locks.

rumors.text: Gem prices dropped after a dwarf hold found 'too many' rubies. The dwarves are hiding the rest.
rumors.followup: The dwarves admitted it. Ruby prices are up again. The dwarves are very pleased.

rumors.text: A gnome invented a coin that's worth exactly what you think it's worth. Banks are furious.
rumors.followup: The gnome's coin was outlawed. Banks now issue coins that are worth exactly what the bank thinks.

rumors.text: Mercenary wages are down because the goblins are working for scale.
rumors.followup: The goblins have formed a union. Wages are back up and so are the goblins.

rumors.text: The harbor tariff now applies to 'any vessel,' including flasks. Sailors are smuggling rum in their boots.
rumors.followup: Sailors now hide rum in their hats. The tariff is being extended to hats.

rumors.text: A dragon is short-selling the kingdom.
rumors.followup: The dragon lost its bet when the kingdom found a gold mine. It has eaten its broker.

rumors.text: Pawnshops are full of +1 daggers nobody wants. The market for slightly magic cutlery has collapsed.
rumors.followup: A gnome bought every +1 dagger and melted them into a +7 spoon. It is unsettlingly effective.

rumors.text: The new bridge toll costs more than the ferry, which costs more than swimming, which costs a leg if you meet the eels.
rumors.followup: The eels have started charging a toll too. Swimming is now the most expensive way across.

rumors.text: Wool is scarce because the sheep are wearing it. A druid is involved.
rumors.followup: The druid was asked to shear the sheep. The sheep were asked first. They said no.

rumors.text: The bank vault is guarded by a mimic that has started charging its own storage fee.
rumors.followup: The mimic was promoted to head of security. Its storage fee is now the bank's main income.

rumors.text: Every shop in the market raised prices on the same morning. Every shopkeeper swears it was a coincidence.
rumors.followup: A guild of shopkeepers was found to exist. Prices went back down by exactly one copper.

rumors.text: Guild membership now requires a guild membership, which requires a guild membership.
rumors.followup: The loophole was found: you can join the guild by founding it.

rumors.text: A merchant is selling 'genuine bottled moonlight.' Sales are excellent on cloudy nights.
rumors.followup: A cleric tested it. It is bottled lamplight. Sales are still excellent.

rumors.text: A shipment of healing potions arrived with every bottle full of pickle brine. Find out where the real ones went.
rumors.followup: The real potions were sold to a pickle merchant. His pickles are now very healthy.

rumors.text: A banker needs a 'discreet' escort to move gold between vaults. The gold is fine. The banker is the target.
rumors.followup: The banker was attacked. The gold was fine. The banker is now under the vault.

rumors.text: Someone is flooding the market with counterfeit platinum. The forgeries are better than the real thing.
rumors.followup: The forger was hired by the mint to improve its coins.

rumors.text: A caravan master needs guards for a run through goblin country. The goblins want a cut, not a fight.
rumors.followup: The goblins took a cut, then took a liking to the caravan master. He has a new tribe now.

rumors.text: The spice merchant's ledger is written in a code that changes nightly. The guild will pay to have it cracked.
rumors.followup: The code was broken. Every entry said "cinnamon." The guild is not sure what that means either.

rumors.text: Debt collectors are vanishing on the road to the old manor. The debtor seems very relaxed about it.
rumors.followup: The debtor is a vampire. The debt has been forgiven, nervously.

rumors.text: A trading company wants proof its rival is using enchanted scales. Bring evidence, not accusations.
rumors.followup: The scales were enchanted. The rival's scales were also enchanted. Everyone's scales are enchanted.

rumors.text: The silk road has a new toll gate run by a very polite ogre. Negotiate, pay, or relocate him.
rumors.followup: The ogre was offered a pension. He accepted, then reopened the toll gate as a café.

rumors.text: Dock workers are on strike after a kraken ate the foreman. Management wants it 'resolved.' Workers want a new foreman.
rumors.followup: A new foreman was hired. The kraken was given a seat on the board.

rumors.text: An auction house is selling a 'cursed' painting. The buyer wants to know if it's cursed enough to be worth more.
rumors.followup: The painting was cursed. Its price tripled, and the curse is now listed as a feature.

rumors.text: There's a dungeon under the old mill that's never been cleared.
rumors.followup: The dungeon was cleared. A larger dungeon was found under it.

rumors.text: A legendary sword is hidden in the mayor's basement.
rumors.followup: The sword in the basement turned out to be the mayor's old practice sword. It's still legendary to him.

rumors.text: The local quest board hasn't been updated in 50 years.
rumors.followup: The quest board was updated. The first new quest is "update the quest board."

rumors.text: A party of adventurers went into the forest and never came out.
rumors.followup: They came out a week later with a lot of mushrooms and no memory of going in.

rumors.text: There's a treasure map tattooed on someone in this tavern.
rumors.followup: Found him: a half-orc with a map of the realm's best taverns tattooed on his back.

rumors.text: The ancient ruins glow blue during a full moon.
rumors.followup: The ruins glow because a gnome left a lamp on in 1240. The lamp has been switched off.

rumors.text: A wizard is offering 10,000gp for a specific goblin's left ear.
rumors.followup: The wizard got the ear. It belonged to the goblin who stole his lunch.

rumors.text: The cursed amulet everyone's seeking is already in town.
rumors.followup: The amulet is in the pawnshop. It's been there all along, priced at three copper.

rumors.text: There's a portal to the Feywild in the old oak tree.
rumors.followup: The portal works. The fey on the other side would like everyone to stop climbing their tree.

rumors.text: The dungeon's boss is on vacation until next month.
rumors.followup: The boss came back early and was surprised to find the dungeon cleared and his chair taken.

rumors.text: Cave entrance opened after earthquake. Explore it.
rumors.followup: The cave led to a second, older cave full of chairs. Nobody knows why.

rumors.text: Legendary hero's tomb location deciphered. Loot it.
rumors.followup: The tomb was looted by the hero, who wasn't dead and wanted his things back.

rumors.text: Quest board has a blank paper that glows. Touch it.
rumors.followup: The paper read "Quest Accepted." Nobody knows which quest.

rumors.text: Old mine reopened, miners hearing singing. Silence it.
rumors.followup: The miners were humming. They've been asked to stop.

rumors.text: Treasure chest found floating in river. Retrieve it.
rumors.followup: The chest held a smaller chest. Then a smaller chest. Then a letter: "Ha."

rumors.text: Old temple bell ringing underground. Investigate.
rumors.followup: The bell was taken by kobolds. They are ringing it to announce dinner.

rumors.text: Arena needs new challengers for weekend. Sign up.
rumors.followup: The arena got its challengers. One of them was a bear. The bear won.

rumors.text: Dungeon map sold by a blind beggar. Verify it.
rumors.followup: The map was real. The beggar was not blind. He was a cartographer hiding from his publisher.

rumors.text: The old lighthouse hasn't had a keeper in a decade, but the light still comes on every night.
rumors.followup: The lighthouse is kept by a ghost who thinks it's still his shift.

rumors.text: There's a vault under the bank that the bank doesn't know about.
rumors.followup: The bank does know now. It's charging rent.

rumors.text: A dungeon to the east resets every new moon. The traps re-arm and the loot restocks, but nobody knows who does it.
rumors.followup: Someone does reset it: a contractor nobody remembers hiring. He has sent an invoice.

rumors.text: A map seller in the market only sells maps to places that don't exist yet.
rumors.followup: One of the places on her maps opened for business last week.

rumors.text: The ruined keep on the hill has a working kitchen and something in it still cooks.
rumors.followup: The cook is a ghost chef. His soup is excellent and very cold.

rumors.text: The legendary Sword of Ages was melted down for horseshoes. One horse in the stables is very hard to kill.
rumors.followup: A blacksmith confirmed the horse is immortal. The horse is now in the royal guard.

rumors.text: Three adventuring parties have claimed the same dragon's hoard. The dragon is still alive and enjoying the drama.
rumors.followup: The dragon has declared all three parties the winner and eaten the losers.

rumors.text: A sunken temple surfaces once a year for exactly one hour. Next surfacing is next week.
rumors.followup: The temple surfaced. A tour group was waiting with a guide.

rumors.text: The bard's ballad of the Lost Crown has a verse that's actually directions.
rumors.followup: A bard sang the verse and found the crown in a pond. It was a very small crown for a very small king.

rumors.text: A retired adventurer is selling her old gear. One of the boots is still haunted.
rumors.followup: The haunted boot was sold to a cobbler, who has not been able to stop dancing.

rumors.text: The tavern's basement goes down further every time someone checks.
rumors.followup: The basement has stopped growing. It has, however, started a second basement.

rumors.text: Every adventuring party that hires the local guide comes back. Most of them come back missing one member.
rumors.followup: The missing members are fine. They've stayed on as guides.

rumors.text: Somewhere in the forest is a door with no walls. Knock three times and you'll be somewhere else.
rumors.followup: The door was found. Behind it was a slightly different forest. The knocker was the real treasure.

rumors.text: A wizard's tower appeared overnight on the north road. The wizard seems surprised too.
rumors.followup: The wizard was surprised because the tower is his old one from a different century.

rumors.text: The abandoned mine has fresh footprints going in and none coming out. The footprints are small.
rumors.followup: The footprints belong to a gnome mining company that has never once left.

rumors.text: A dying knight left her shield to 'whoever finishes what I started.' Nobody knows what she started.
rumors.followup: She started a war against the moon. Nobody has finished it yet.

rumors.text: A merchant's daughter went missing near the old barrow. The ransom note was signed by a ghost.
rumors.followup: The ghost was the daughter herself, who wanted ransom money to fund her own adventuring career.

rumors.text: Something has been eating the bridge trolls. The trolls would like protection. The town would like to know what eats trolls.
rumors.followup: A larger troll has been eating the trolls. The trolls have asked for a protection racket of their own.

rumors.text: An expedition into the glacier hasn't reported in a month. Their last letter said 'Do not follow.' Pay is double.
rumors.followup: The expedition is fine. They found a hot spring and decided not to come back.

rumors.text: A treasure hunter needs a party to retrieve a crown from a crypt she 'definitely didn't trigger the traps in.'
rumors.followup: The traps had been triggered. She just didn't notice.

rumors.text: A ship came into harbor with no crew and a full hold. The harbormaster wants to know where they went.
rumors.followup: The crew was found on a nearby island having a picnic. They had forgotten the ship.

rumors.text: The monastery on the cliff stopped ringing its bells. The road up there has new tracks. Big ones.
rumors.followup: The bells were stolen by a giant who wanted to start a band.

rumors.text: An old map shows a dwarven city under the hills. The dwarves say it was abandoned for a reason.
rumors.followup: The city was abandoned because the dwarves couldn't agree on a mayor. They still can't.

rumors.text: Bandits are robbing travelers and leaving thank-you notes. Find their camp. Return the notes.
rumors.followup: The camp was found. So were more thank-you notes, addressed to the party.

rumors.text: A noble's heir needs 'adventuring experience' to inherit. Take him on a quest and bring him back mostly intact.
rumors.followup: The heir came back with a scar, a sword, and a burning desire to never inherit anything.

rumors.text: The island off the coast reappeared after fifty years of fog. The first boat out found an empty town, set for dinner.
rumors.followup: Dinner was still warm. Nobody has dared sit down.

rumors.text: A golem is guarding a crossroads and won't let anyone pass without the password. Nobody alive knows it.
rumors.followup: The password was "password." The golem is very embarrassed.

rumors.text: Someone stole a famous paladin's horse. The horse is also a paladin.
rumors.followup: The horse has been found leading a charge against a nearby goblin camp. It is not coming back.

rumors.text: A haunted inn is for sale cheap. The buyer wants the ghosts evicted, politely, before signing.
rumors.followup: The ghosts agreed to leave if the new owner kept the haunted piano. He kept it.

rumors.text: A cartographer will pay well for a map of the Shifting Maze. Previous mappers are still in it.
rumors.followup: The maze has a map now. The map shifts too.

rumors.text: An archaeologist found a tomb sealed from the inside. She needs muscle to open it and courage to look.
rumors.followup: She looked. Inside was the archaeologist's grandfather, who had locked himself in to win a bet.

rumors.text: Somebody is digging up the old battlefield at night. The bones are being carted somewhere east.
rumors.followup: The bones were taken to a necromancer's job fair.

rumors.text: The mountain pass is blocked by an avalanche that keeps rebuilding itself. Dig through or find what's casting it.
rumors.followup: The avalanche was a stone giant's hobby. He has taken up knitting instead.

rumors.text: A red dragon has been spotted near the northern pass.
rumors.followup: The red dragon has landed in the northern pass and is charging a toll. The toll is "everyone's sheep."

rumors.text: Goblins are unionizing and demanding better working conditions.
rumors.followup: The goblins won. They now get two breaks a day and dental.

rumors.text: The local owlbear is actually two animals in a costume.
rumors.followup: It was two animals in a costume: an owl and a bear. They have asked to be left alone together.

rumors.text: A beholder is running the local eye clinic.
rumors.followup: The beholder's clinic has been closed. Its eye charts were too judgmental.

rumors.text: Werewolves are exempt from the full moon curfew.
rumors.followup: The full moon curfew now has a special lane for werewolves. Nobody wants to stand in it.

rumors.text: The swamp witch accepts payment in memories.
rumors.followup: Someone paid with the memory of how to pay. The witch is still trying to collect.

rumors.text: A troll is working as a bouncer at the fancy district.
rumors.followup: The troll was fired for eating a guest. He claims the guest was rude.

rumors.text: Dragons now accept cryptocurrency for hoard insurance.
rumors.followup: The dragons want gold again. Their "crypto" was a hoard of glass beads.

rumors.text: The local mimic population has infiltrated the furniture district.
rumors.followup: A woman sat in a chair. The chair sat back. The furniture district has been closed.

rumors.text: A mind flayer is running the town's therapy practice.
rumors.followup: The therapist was a mind flayer. His clients have never felt so understood or so empty.

rumors.text: Wyvern nesting on the bell tower. Remove it.
rumors.followup: The wyvern was removed. It has taken up residence on the town hall, which is taller.

rumors.text: Ogre demanding toll at the bridge. Negotiate or kill.
rumors.followup: The ogre was paid off. He has set up a second toll bridge for the toll bridge.

rumors.text: Chimera spotted near the sheep pasture. Hunt it.
rumors.followup: The chimera was hunted. Two of its heads surrendered. The third is still at large.

rumors.text: Kobolds digging under the bank. Stop them.
rumors.followup: The kobolds had already dug through the vault. They were just looking for a quiet place to nap.

rumors.text: Griffon attacking mail delivery birds. Ground it.
rumors.followup: The griffon has been given a job delivering mail. The birds are furious.

rumors.text: Troll under bridge wants union rep. Mediate.
rumors.followup: The troll got his union rep. The rep is also a troll, and they now share the bridge and the tolls.

rumors.text: Beholder eye stalks found in the market. Find the body.
rumors.followup: The body was found. It belongs to a very lost, very cross beholder.

rumors.text: Druid circle reporting missing treants. Find them.
rumors.followup: The treants were found dancing in a field, refusing to come home.

rumors.text: Goblins selling knock-off healing potions. Raid them.
rumors.followup: The potions were raided. They were water. The goblins are now selling "raid insurance."

rumors.text: Displacer beast stealing livestock. Track it.
rumors.followup: The beast was tracked to a farm, where it was guarding the livestock from other displacer beasts.

rumors.text: The kobolds in the hills have elected a dragon as mayor. The dragon doesn't know yet.
rumors.followup: The dragon found out and has passed six new laws, all about gold.

rumors.text: A gelatinous cube has been cleaning the sewers for years. The sanitation guild calls it a coworker.
rumors.followup: The cube was promoted. The sanitation guild has never been cleaner or more frightened.

rumors.text: The harpies on the coast have started a choir. Ships are crashing more politely now.
rumors.followup: Ships still crash, but now they crash in harmony.

rumors.text: A vampire in the old manor has gone vegetarian. He's very cranky about it.
rumors.followup: The vampire went back to blood. He says vegetables were "too much drama."

rumors.text: Owlbears are nesting closer to town every spring. The rangers blame the honey farms.
rumors.followup: The rangers moved the honey farms. The owlbears moved too.

rumors.text: A hydra has been spotted near the river. It's fine, it's only got one head. For now.
rumors.followup: It now has two heads. They're already arguing.

rumors.text: The goblins aren't raiding the farms anymore. They're buying from them. Nobody knows where they got the money.
rumors.followup: The goblins are paying in gold coins stamped with the farmers' own faces. Nobody has asked where they got them.

rumors.text: A lich's phylactery was sold at a yard sale as a 'spooky trinket.' The buyer has been feeling very motivated lately.
rumors.followup: The buyer used the phylactery as a doorstop. The lich is too embarrassed to come for it.

rumors.text: Ghouls in the cemetery have formed a book club. They're on chapter two of a cookbook.
rumors.followup: They finished the cookbook. They're now writing one.

rumors.text: The ogre on the toll bridge has a law degree and will argue every coin.
rumors.followup: The ogre won his case. He is now a judge.

rumors.text: Giant spiders moved into the abandoned silk mill and the silk is excellent now.
rumors.followup: The silk is so good that the spiders were granted a royal warrant.

rumors.text: Zombies have been seen standing in line outside the healer's. Nobody wants to tell them.
rumors.followup: The healer has started treating the zombies. They have very few complaints.

rumors.text: There's a dragon living under the tavern. That's why the floor is always warm.
rumors.followup: The floor is warm because of a hot spring. The dragon is the spring's landlord.

rumors.text: The lake monster is real, but it's shy and the 'sightings' are just a very large carp.
rumors.followup: The carp has been named the official lake monster. The real monster is very upset about it.

rumors.text: Gnolls are trading hyena pups at the border market. Several nobles have bought one. Several nobles are missing fingers.
rumors.followup: The pups grew up. The nobles are now missing more fingers.

rumors.text: A banshee in the old keep only wails on tax day. Locals call it reasonable.
rumors.followup: The banshee has started wailing on rent day too. Locals are less understanding.

rumors.text: The basilisk at the menagerie is wearing a blindfold. The statues around its pen are former keepers.
rumors.followup: The basilisk's blindfold slipped. The menagerie has a new statue garden.

rumors.text: A medusa opened a sculpture gallery. Critics praise the realism.
rumors.followup: The gallery's newest exhibit is the critic who said it was "a little stiff."

rumors.text: The minotaur in the labyrinth is tired of the maze and just wants a map like everyone else.
rumors.followup: Someone gave the minotaur a map. He left. The labyrinth is now empty and very confusing.

rumors.text: Something is eating sheep and leaving the wool folded neatly. Find it and ask about its manners.
rumors.followup: The sheep-eater was a dragon with excellent table manners. It has offered to pay for the sheep.

rumors.text: A wyvern nested on the cathedral spire. The bishop wants it moved before the holy day.
rumors.followup: The wyvern was moved. It took the spire with it.

rumors.text: Trolls are regenerating faster than the watch can burn them. Find the source of the fire-proofing.
rumors.followup: The fire-proofing came from a gnome selling fireproof cloaks. Trolls have bought them all.

rumors.text: A hag is offering farmers a 'better harvest' for a small favor. Find out what the favor is.
rumors.followup: The favor was "one firstborn." The farmers read the small print too late.

rumors.text: Rats in the granary are organized, armed, and demanding grain. A wererat is suspected.
rumors.followup: The wererat was caught. The rats elected a new leader within the hour.

rumors.text: A young dragon has claimed the old watchtower and is charging rent. Evict it, negotiate, or pay up.
rumors.followup: The dragon was evicted. It now rents a room above the tavern and pays on time.

rumors.text: Will-o'-wisps are leading travelers off the marsh road. The last missing traveler was carrying the payroll.
rumors.followup: The payroll was found in the marsh. The wisps had been using it to light the way.

rumors.text: A manticore is terrorizing the southern pass and taunting the guards by name. Someone told it their names.
rumors.followup: It was the town crier. He was trying to get the manticore to say his name back.

rumors.text: The ghost of a jilted bride haunts the chapel every wedding. The couple getting married next week wants her gone.
rumors.followup: The bride was persuaded to leave. She has instead opened a wedding-planning business.

rumors.text: A chimera escaped a wizard's menagerie and its three heads disagree about where to go.
rumors.followup: The chimera split up. Three smaller problems are now terrorizing three villages.

rumors.text: Stirges are swarming the vineyards. The winemaker says this year's vintage is 'full-bodied.'
rumors.followup: The vintage won a prize. The judges have been very pale since.

rumors.text: A gorgon has been seen grazing in the royal pastures. The royal livestock are now very still.
rumors.followup: The gorgon was led away. The royal livestock are still very still. They are now statues.

rumors.text: Casting fireball indoors is now a misdemeanor.
rumors.followup: Fireball indoors is now a felony. Fireball outdoors has become very popular.

rumors.text: The local wizard's tower has more floors on the inside.
rumors.followup: The tower has more floors inside. One floor has a door to the outside of a different tower.

rumors.text: Potions expire after 30 days and turn into poison.
rumors.followup: Potions don't turn into poison. They do, however, start to taste like regret.

rumors.text: There's a spell that can make your hair grow back instantly.
rumors.followup: The spell exists. It grows hair everywhere except the head.

rumors.text: The archmage is actually 12 gnomes in a robe.
rumors.followup: The gnomes have been found out. The archmage is now 13 gnomes, after a promotion.

rumors.text: Magic missiles are causing a shortage of small birds.
rumors.followup: The shortage was caused by a large flock of wizards practicing on pigeons.

rumors.text: Scrolls of resurrection come with a 30-day money-back guarantee.
rumors.followup: The guarantee was honored. The buyer came back dead and got a refund.

rumors.text: The local ley lines are causing WiFi interference.
rumors.followup: The ley lines were moved. Now the tavern's lanterns flicker every time someone casts a spell.

rumors.text: A cursed mirror shows you your alternate universe self.
rumors.followup: The alternate self is happier. It has asked to switch places.

rumors.text: Teleportation circles require a subscription service now.
rumors.followup: The subscription was cancelled. Teleportation is now pay-per-trip, with tips.

rumors.text: Wild magic zone appeared in the park. Contain it.
rumors.followup: The wild magic zone has been fenced off. The fence is now made of cheese.

rumors.text: Potion shop exploded, need cleanup crew. Hazard pay.
rumors.followup: The cleanup crew found a potion of unlimited mess. Hazard pay has been doubled.

rumors.text: Scroll of resurrection found in a gutter. Return it.
rumors.followup: The scroll belonged to a cleric who dropped it while dying. He has asked for it back.

rumors.text: Wizard tower floating away slowly. Anchor it.
rumors.followup: The tower was anchored. The anchor has started floating.

rumors.text: Enchanted sword won't stop singing. Disenchant it.
rumors.followup: The sword was disenchanted. It now hums.

rumors.text: Potion of invisibility stuck permanent. Fix it.
rumors.followup: The potion wore off, but only for the parts that matter. The rest is still invisible.

rumors.text: Teleportation circle sending people to wrong city. Repair it.
rumors.followup: The circle was repaired, but now sends people to the right city in the wrong year.

rumors.text: Cursed mirror trapping reflections. Break it.
rumors.followup: The mirror was broken. The trapped reflections are now loose in the town and very rude.

rumors.text: Apprentice turned himself into a teapot. Reverse it.
rumors.followup: The apprentice was reversed. He still pours tea from his nose when he sneezes.

rumors.text: Magic broom sweeping uncontrollably. Stop it.
rumors.followup: The broom was stopped. It has since applied for a job in the castle.

rumors.text: The wizard's college failed its accreditation because half the faculty are illusions.
rumors.followup: The college regained its accreditation by hiring illusions of accreditors.

rumors.text: A love potion is going around that only works on people who already liked you, which is technically still a love potion.
rumors.followup: A study showed the potion works. Two old friends have been married in a hurry.

rumors.text: Every apprentice's first fireball sets their eyebrows on fire. It's considered a rite of passage.
rumors.followup: An apprentice set someone else's eyebrows on fire. The tradition now has a rule book.

rumors.text: A spell of perfect memory exists, but everyone who casts it forgets where they wrote it down.
rumors.followup: Someone found the scroll. It was in their own handwriting. They don't remember writing it.

rumors.text: The enchanter on Bell Street sells 'glowing' swords that are just very well-polished.
rumors.followup: A buyer tested a polished sword in battle. It glowed briefly. With embarrassment.

rumors.text: Scrolls bought at the night market have a habit of being in a language the buyer can't read.
rumors.followup: The night market now sells language scrolls too. They are in another language.

rumors.text: A wish was granted last month. Nobody will admit to it, but the town has a lot more geese.
rumors.followup: The geese were the wish. The wisher wanted "a gaggle of friends."

rumors.text: Prestidigitation is banned in the bakery after an apprentice flavored every loaf like cinnamon.
rumors.followup: The bakery allows prestidigitation again, but only for frosting.

rumors.text: Somewhere in the city is a door that only opens for people who've never lied. It's been closed for ninety years.
rumors.followup: The door opened last week. A toddler walked through. Nobody is sure what's on the other side.

rumors.text: The alchemist's guild accidentally invented a potion of mild inconvenience. It's selling well as a prank gift.
rumors.followup: The potion of mild inconvenience is now prescribed to people who are too calm.

rumors.text: The moon is slowly being enchanted by someone with a very long ladder.
rumors.followup: The ladder has been found. The moon is now slightly more shiny on one side.

rumors.text: Magic users have to register their familiars now. The cats are refusing to sign.
rumors.followup: The cats have hired a lawyer. The registration law is being appealed.

rumors.text: A sorcerer sneezed and turned the town hall purple. That's why the Queen outlawed the color.
rumors.followup: The Queen denies the sneeze. The town hall remains purple.

rumors.text: Wands sold in the market come pre-charged, mostly with lint.
rumors.followup: A wand was tested. It fired lint at a dragon. The dragon was more confused than hurt.

rumors.text: The library's restricted section restricts itself. Books move away from people who aren't ready.
rumors.followup: The restricted section restricted the librarian. He has not been seen since.

rumors.text: The archmage's tower has a waiting list of apprentices that goes back three generations.
rumors.followup: The waiting list now has a waiting list.

rumors.text: A cantrip has been discovered that makes your boots never get wet. The cobblers want it suppressed.
rumors.followup: The cobblers succeeded. The cantrip is banned, and wet socks are a patriotic duty.

rumors.text: Identify spells cost more this season because 'everyone's finding things.'
rumors.followup: The guild of identify now charges a fee to identify whether you need to identify.

rumors.text: A crystal ball in the pawnshop only shows the future of the pawnshop.
rumors.followup: It shows the pawnshop burning down next week. The owner has started selling everything.

rumors.text: An apprentice summoned something and can't unsummon it. It's polite but won't leave.
rumors.followup: The summoned thing has taken a job at the inn. It's the best waiter they've ever had.

rumors.text: All the mirrors in the mage's guild show a room that isn't there. Find the room.
rumors.followup: The room was found behind the guild's own fireplace. It was full of guild members from last year.

rumors.text: A wizard died mid-spell and the spell is still going. Half of his street is in last Tuesday.
rumors.followup: Half the street has started celebrating last Tuesday's festival again. Nobody wants it to stop.

rumors.text: A spellbook was stolen from the academy. It contains a spell that should never be cast twice.
rumors.followup: The spellbook was found. The spell had already been cast once. Nobody knows when.

rumors.text: Rain falling on the north district is coming down upward. The weather mage is on holiday.
rumors.followup: The rain stopped falling upward. Now it's falling sideways.

rumors.text: Magic items in town are going dim one by one. Something is drinking the enchantments.
rumors.followup: The thing drinking enchantments was a young dragon with a magic allergy. It has been given a cure.

rumors.text: A portal opened in the town square and only cats come through it. Thousands of cats.
rumors.followup: The cats stopped coming. The portal has started sending dogs.

rumors.text: The city's ward stones are cracking. The mages say it's fine. The mages are packing.
rumors.followup: The ward stones were replaced. The mages are unpacking, slowly.

rumors.text: A bard's song is cursed. Everyone who hums it ends up in the same cave.
rumors.followup: The cave has a stage now. The cursed fans are staying for the encore.

rumors.text: Shadows in the merchant quarter are detaching and wandering off. Find out where they go.
rumors.followup: The shadows were following a lamplighter who set off on vacation.

rumors.text: A retired wizard wants her old tower cleared of everything she 'left running.'
rumors.followup: The tower was cleared. The last thing she left running was a spell to clear the tower.

rumors.text: Someone is selling resurrection scrolls that bring back the wrong person.
rumors.followup: The wrong people were the right people for someone else. A swap meet is being organized.
